summary: Drain never-offered mailbox backlog in oldest-first batches of five, opening the next batch only after every member is delivered or withdrawn

replay.detail: Stream connections and recipient polling boot sessions recover one outstanding batch of at most five backlog messages. The next batch opens when every member has delivered/read evidence or is terminally closed (withdrawn); staging, offering and elapsed time do not settle a member, so a stuck harness never holds more than five. Withdrawal creates no delivered/read receipt. Stream receipt changes trigger refill without reconnecting. The seven-day cutoff, one-hour recent exemption, silent waits, existing intake holds and prior uncertain-attempt holds are unchanged.

schema.detail: No database schema or stored-format changes; outstanding batches remain daemon-local.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or fleet coordination changes.

compatibility.detail: No wire or harness protocol changes. Receipts remain per message; both recovery paths share one settlement predicate.

recovery.detail: Rollback restores the five-message session cap without refill. Existing staging, receipt and withdrawal history remains authoritative and does not authorize replay of uncertain offers.
